The '''2020–21 DePaul Blue Demons men's basketball team''' represented [[DePaul University]] during the [[2020–21 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. They were led by sixth-year (ninth overall with DePaul) head coach [[Dave Leitao]] and played their home games at [[Wintrust Arena]] in [[Chicago|Chicago, Illinois]] as members of the [[Big East Conference]]. In a season limited due to the ongoing [[COVID-19 pandemic in the United States|COVID-19 pandemic]], the Demons finished the season 5–14, 2–13 in [[2020–21 Big East Conference men's basketball season|Big East play]] to finish in last place. They defeated [[2020–21 Providence Friars men's basketball team|Providence]] in the first round of the [[2021 Big East men's basketball tournament|Big East tournament]] before losing to [[2020–21 UConn Huskies men's basketball team|UConn]] in the quarterfinals.

After finishing in last place in the Big East for a fifth consecutive year, the school fired head coach Leitao on March 15, 2021.<ref>{{Cite web|date=2021-03-15|title=DePaul fires Leitao after 5 straight seasons in last|url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/story/_/id/31070716/sources-depaul-blue-demons-fire-dave-leitao-5-straight-last-place-finishes|access-date=2021-09-20|website=ESPN.com|language=en}}</ref> On April 1, the school named longtime [[Oregon Ducks men's basketball|Oregon]] assistant [[Tony Stubblefield]] the team's new head coach.<ref>{{Cite web|title=AP source: DePaul hires Oregon's Tony Stubblefield as coach|url=https://www.usatoday.com/story/sports/ncaab/2021/04/01/ap-source-depaul-hires-oregons-tony-stubblefield-as-coach/43511135/|access-date=2021-09-20|website=USA TODAY|language=en-US}}</ref>

==Previous season==
The [[2019–20 DePaul Blue Demons men's basketball team|Blue Demons]] finished the [[2019–20 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2019–20 season]] 16–16, 3–15 in [[2019–20 Big East Conference men's basketball season|Big East play]] to finish in last place. They defeated [[2019–20 Xavier Musketeers men's basketball team|Xavier]] in the first round of the [[2020 Big East men's basketball tournament|Big East tournament]]<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/recap?gameId=401210944|title=DePaul vs. Xavier - Game Recap - March 11, 2020 - ESPN|website=ESPN.com|language=en|access-date=2020-04-13}}</ref> before the remaining tournament was canceled due to the [[COVID-19 pandemic in the United States|COVID-19 pandemic]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.si.com/college/2020/03/12/big-east-tournament-canceled-halftime-game-coronavirus|title=Big East Cancels Tournament Over Coronavirus|last=West|first=Jenna|website=Sports Illustrated|language=en-us|access-date=2020-04-13}}</ref>

== Schedule and results ==
Due to the ongoing coronavirus pandemic, the start of the season was pushed back from the scheduled start of November 10.<ref>{{Cite web|title=NCAA committees pushing for Nov. 25 as the start date for the 2020-21 college basketball season|url=https://www.cbssports.com/college-basketball/news/ncaa-committees-pushing-for-nov-25-as-the-start-date-for-the-2020-21-college-basketball-season/|access-date=2020-09-04|website=CBSSports.com|language=en}}</ref> On September 16, 2020, the NCAA announced that November 25 would be the new start date.<ref>{{Cite web|date=2020-09-16|title=NCAA: Men's, women's hoops can start Nov. 25|url=https://www.espn.com/college-sports/story/_/id/29900866/sources-ncaa-college-basketball-season-start-nov-25|access-date=2020-09-23|website=ESPN.com|language=en}}</ref> On November 19, the school announced that it was pausing all men's basketball activities due to positive COVID-19 test results and canceled the first three games of the season.<ref>{{Cite web|last=staff|first=Sun-Times|date=2020-11-19|title=DePaul cancels first three games of basketball season after positive coronavirus tests|url=https://chicago.suntimes.com/2020/11/19/21578469/depaul-coronavirus-cancels-first-three-games-of-basketball-season-covid-19|access-date=2020-11-20|website=Chicago Sun-Times|language=en}}</ref><ref name=":0">{{Cite web|date=2020-11-19|title=DePaul cancels 3 games after COVID positives|url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/story/_/id/30349969/depaul-men-basketball-cancels-first-three-games-season-due-covid-19|access-date=2020-11-20|website=ESPN.com|language=en}}</ref> On January 2, 2021, the game against St. John's was postponed due to COVID-19 issues at St. John's.<ref>{{Cite web|last=Rose|first=Norman|date=2021-01-02|title=St. John's vs DePaul postponed due to COVID|url=https://www.rumbleinthegarden.com/2021/1/2/22210350/st-johns-covid-19-depaul-postponed|access-date=2021-01-11|website=Rumble In The Garden|language=en}}</ref> On January 4, the January 5 game against Villanova was postponed due to COVID-19 issues at Villanova.<ref>{{Cite web|title=DePaul-Villanova Game Postponed Due to COVID-19 Protocols|url=https://depaulbluedemons.com/news/2021/1/4/mens-basketball-depaul-villanova-game-postponed-due-to-covid-19-protocols.aspx|access-date=2021-01-11|website=DePaul University Athletics|language=en}}</ref>
